conf.description: syslog-relay/syslog-ng-stats prometheus: parses a full stats-exporter scrape (or syslog-ng-ctl stats --format=prometheus) exposition-text blob line by line, normalizes the syslogng_* metric families and their driver/id/result labels onto the shared syslog_ng.stats.* namespace used by the other two formats.

conf.comment: Prometheus exposition text from stats-exporter or 'syslog-ng-ctl stats --format=prometheus'. One event is assumed to carry the whole scrape/dump (multiple metric lines), parsed here as a blob rather than pre-split. No scrape-time/host field is named by the map - _time/host left to source default (README gap).

functions.description: document the exposition-text assumption and the collector-metadata gap

conf.code: var lines = (__e['_raw']||'').split('\n'); __e.syslog_ng = __e.syslog_ng || {}; __e.syslog_ng.stats = __e.syslog_ng.stats || {}; var metricMap = {'syslogng_input_events_total':'processed','syslogng_destination_processed':'processed','syslogng_socket_connections':'connections'}; for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { var line = lines[i].trim(); if (!line || line.charAt(0) === '#') continue; var m = line.match(/^([a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:]*)(\{([^}]*)\})?\s+([0-9eE+\-.]+)\s*$/); if (!m) continue; var metric = m[1]; var labelStr = m[3] || ''; var value = Number(m[4]); var labels = {}; var lm; var re = /([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)="((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"/g; while ((lm = re.exec(labelStr)) !== null) { labels[lm[1]] = lm[2]; } var id = labels.id || labels.driver || 'unlabeled'; __e.syslog_ng.stats[id] = __e.syslog_ng.stats[id] || {}; if (labels.id) { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id].object_id = labels.id; } if (labels.driver) { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id].object_type = labels.driver; } if (labels.result) { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id].result = labels.result; } if (metric === 'syslogng_internal_events_total') { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id][labels.result === 'dropped' ? 'dropped' : ('internal_' + (labels.result || 'unknown'))] = value; } else if (metric === 'syslogng_output_events_total') { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id][labels.result === 'dropped' ? 'dropped' : 'written'] = value; } else if (metricMap[metric]) { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id][metricMap[metric]] = value; } else { __e.syslog_ng.stats[id][metric] = value; } }

functions.description: parse every exposition line in the blob, lift the driver/id/result labels, and normalize the syslogng_* metric families onto syslog_ng.stats.{processed,written,dropped,connections,result} keyed by object id - unmapped metric names fall back to their literal name so nothing is silently lost
stamp the daemon identity (no PROGRAM-equivalent field on this format) and set event.dataset
